g.text: ActionDecision carries request identity for stale-result rejection. MovementIntent deliberately contains no request identity or running timer.
Values listed by name in attributes and method signatures are shared between the packages above.
Timer expiry and spoken stop preserve it.
Pause, fall, restart and current errors clear it.
REPEAT_LAST creates fresh commands, once per utterance.
GameModel is the command receiver and observer subject.
One serialized application loop owns all mutable game/control state.
Each fall cancels controls and restores Level.start(); there are no checkpoints.
Views implement GameView; GameView extends GameObserver.
CliView plans a JLine status panel and editable prompt, with a plain-terminal fallback.
Terminal, Status, Parent and CompletionStage are library types.
DashboardReader is a private CliView helper.
Say Swear - Stage 1 revised Java design
Read top to bottom within each package. Key methods are shown; concrete classes inherit interface operations.
One selected GUI/CLI shares the controller, game, controls and agent. AI receives control context only; the human chooses the route.
Typed attributes/results also express value dependencies. CompletionStage abbreviates CompletionStage<ActionDecision>.
